#!/usr/bin/env bash
# Daily backup of /workspace into /workspace/backups
set -euo pipefail

SRC="/workspace"
DEST_DIR="/workspace/backups"
STAMP="$(date +%F)"
DEST="${DEST_DIR}/${STAMP}.tar.gz"

mkdir -p "$DEST_DIR"

# Exclude the backups dir itself, git internals, and transient files
tar --exclude="$DEST_DIR" \
    --exclude="$SRC/.git" \
    --exclude="$SRC/tmp" \
    -czf "$DEST" -C "$(dirname "$SRC")" "$(basename "$SRC")"

# Keep the 14 most recent backups
ls -1t "$DEST_DIR"/*.tar.gz 2>/dev/null | tail -n +15 | xargs -r rm -f --

echo "Backup created: $DEST"
